description: This is a test source file containing unit tests for the App component of a Blazor application, specifically testing authentication and routing behaviors.

classes.name: AppRenderTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the rendering and authorization behavior of the App component in a Blazor web application.

methods.name: App_NotAuthenticated_AdminRoute_Renders_RedirectToLogin
methods.description: Tests that an unauthenticated user attempting to access the /admin route is redirected to the login page via RenderComponent.

methods.name: App_Authorized_NotInRole_Shows_NotAuthorized_Message
methods.description: Tests that an authorized user without the 'admin' role sees a 'Not Authorized' message.

methods.name: App_Authorized_AdminRole_Renders_Admin_List_Page
methods.description: Tests that an authorized user with the 'admin' role sees the admin list page content.

methods.name: App_UnknownRoute_Renders_NotFound_Message
methods.description: Tests that navigating to an undefined route renders the 'not found' message.
